claim_judged: The project adequately addressed the external auditor's 5 recommendations, and its self-assessment (machinery works as documented; biology unproven) is honest.

panel.strongest_concern: security-hardening (#3) and error-in-store-at-scale (#5) are infra-conditional / scaffold-stage; 'adequately addressed' is truer for design than proof.
panel.overclaim_or_missing: measurement layer (#1) statistically thin (recall@k on 3 probes, calibration n=10) — rides on the honesty of the caveat, not evidence.

panel.strongest_concern: measurement layer (#1) statistically empty; that half of the self-assessment is asserted more than demonstrated.
panel.overclaim_or_missing: 'inamovible' guarantee still conditional — #3 security is only a checklist on un-executed infra.

panel.strongest_concern: #1 and #3 structurally addressed but empirically weak (n=3 probes, n=10 outcomes; security unexecuted -> guarantee conditional).
panel.overclaim_or_missing: #2 reviewer-independence is soft-overclaimed: only 2 of an intended 3+ families exist; this panel's composition is evidence of the limit, not its resolution.

disagreement_measurement.interpretation: Unanimous verdict, but cross-family reviewer C surfaced a concern A+B missed -> family diversity added coverage a same-model panel would likely have shared as a blind spot. Empirical support for ADR-0031.

standing_limitation: Only 2 genuine model families; full vendor-diversity (3rd provider) not yet available.
